summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K to disclose a routine committee composition change: the Board of Directors approved the (re)election of members for the Statutory Compliance and Audit Committee, including Gesner José de Oliveira Filho, Paulo Roberto Britto Guimarães, José Mauro M. Carneiro da Cunha, Gustavo Raldi Tancini, and Maria Helena Pettersson. No financial terms, premiums, or strategic transactions are involved. This is an ordinary governance update under Brazilian CVM rules, equivalent to a routine US transparency filing. There is no special-situation event; the change is procedural and unrelated to a merger, acquisition, or activist campaign. What to watch: none.
